steps.name: 01 Settings
steps.goal: If an iOS system sheet asks for an Apple Account password, tap its Cancel button; never type into a password field. Then open Settings: tap the Navigation button (top left, labelled Navigation. Computer: ...), then tap Settings in the side menu. Note: a session card whose title begins with Error: is the name of a task someone typed, not an app error, so the screen is not blocked.
steps.done: The Settings screen with a Coding agents row and a Connectors row under it

steps.name: 02 Connectors
steps.done: The native Connectors screen: a note that what you connect works for everyone on your team, and a list of apps (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Sheets), each with a Connect or Add button
expect: works for everyone on your team

steps.name: 03 Connect opens the sign-in
steps.goal: Tap the Connect button on the Google Calendar row (its label is Connect Google Calendar, or Add another Google Calendar account). Do not tap anything else.
steps.done: iOS shows the system prompt that omg wants to use a website to sign in, or a Google sign-in page is open

steps.name: 04 Cancel returns to the list
steps.goal: Cancel the sign-in: tap Cancel on the system prompt, or close the sign-in page. Do not sign in.
steps.done: Back on the Connectors list with the Google Calendar row and no error message
expect: works for everyone on your team
